spec.objective: Make executor failover REAL and EFFECTIVE. Live test exposed three gaps: Grok hit its token limit mid-task and the system never failed over to Qwen; the Qwen fallback abandons even trivial tasks; and orchestrator review feedback never reaches the executor. Fix all three so the primary→fallback handoff is automatic and the fallback can actually complete work.
constraints: PART 1 (CRITICAL, demo-proven) — Qwen tool-call parsing. Ollama's /v1 chat for qwen2.5-coder:7b returns tool calls as JSON in message.content with the structured `tool_calls` field NULL (verified: content = '{"name":"read_file","arguments":{...}}'). The loop in qwen-executor.ts only reads choice.tool_calls, so it sees no tool use and abandons after 1 round. Fix ollama-client.ts/qwen-executor.ts to also detect+parse content-embedded tool-call JSON (single object or array) when tool_calls is absent, and to re-prompt rather than break when a turn yields neither a tool call nor a staged patch (up to max_repair_rounds).

PART 2 — Liveness + mid-task reroute. Executors must run THROUGH the dispatch layer (not interactively). Detect primary (grok) failure mid-task — process exit / token-limit error / stall timeout — and automatically reroute the SAME task to the qwen fallback. The comms watcher's silence != healthy; add an explicit liveness signal.

PART 3 — Review-aware repair context. Orchestrator review feedback (comms BLOCKED items and/or task.result review notes) must be injected into the brief/repair context the executor pulls (OrchestratorService.buildExecutorBrief / buildRepairContext), so the fallback acts on review feedback, not just gate errors.
No stubs/TODOs/suppressions; no `as unknown as`; no relative cross-package src imports; gate-only mutations.
acceptance_criteria: PART 1: `janus dispatch --executor qwen -t task-b5e5664d-e549-44a3-a0bf-e185d67c3aa0` (the clamp demo) COMPLETES through the gate (passed:true), proving qwen now parses tool calls and stages a valid patch.
PART 2: a simulated primary-executor failure reroutes the same task to qwen automatically (unit-testable supervisor; no interactive dependency).
PART 3: orchestrator review notes for a task appear in the executor brief/repair context pulled for it (covered by a test).
Full `pnpm -r test` GREEN (gate only typechecks — run tests yourself); `pnpm build`; `pnpm typecheck` clean; zero warnings.
